title: quantile

gpu_support.notes: GPU inputs are gathered to host.

description: `quantile(X,p)` computes sample quantiles along the first nonsingleton dimension using linear interpolation.
behaviors: NaNs are omitted by default in each slice.
`"omitnan"` omits NaNs in each slice; `"includenan"` returns NaN for slices containing NaN.
`"Method","linear"` and `"Method","exact"` use in-memory linear interpolation; `"approximate"` is rejected because tall arrays are not supported here.

faqs.question: How is prctile different?
faqs.answer: `prctile(X,p)` is equivalent to `quantile(X,p/100)` for supported forms.
